nodes.summary: Fix nonempty finite sets `A, B ⊆ ℤ²` of exponent vectors. For generic coefficients, meaning all coefficient vectors off the zero set of some nonzero polynomial in the coefficients, the system `g(x, y) = h(x, y) = 0` with `g = ∑_{u ∈ A} a_u x^{u_0} y^{u_1}` and `h = ∑_{u ∈ B} b_u x^{u_0} y^{u_1}` has finitely many solutions in the torus `(ℂ^*)²`, and their number is the mixed area…
nodes.title: Bernstein's theorem in the plane

nodes.summary: `M(P, Q) = area(P + Q) - area(P) - area(Q)` for plane polygons, with `P + Q` the Minkowski sum and area the Lebesgue measure of `ℝ²` (Sturmfels, CBMS 97, Section 3.1).
nodes.title: Mixed area

nodes.summary: The convex hull in `ℝ²` of a finite set `A ⊆ ℤ²` of exponent vectors (Sturmfels, CBMS 97, Section 3.1, `New(f)`). This is the Laurent analogue of the Newton polygon `NewtonPolygon.newtonPolygon`, which takes a bivariate polynomial with exponents in `ℕ²`.
nodes.title: Newton polygon of a support

nodes.summary: The function `(x, y) ↦ ∑_{u ∈ A} a_u x^{u_0} y^{u_1}` on the torus `(ℂ^*)²`, with support `A` and coefficients `a`.
